title: Glucose Tube
desc: VACUETTE glucose tubes contain sodium fluoride as a glycolysis inhibitor. The anticoagulants K3EDTA, potassium oxalate or sodium heparin prevent the blood from clotting. Depending on the test system, VACUETTE glucose tubes can also be used for lactate assays, with in most cases sodium fluoride being used in combination with potassium oxalate.
